links.comparator_used: Single global Youden threshold applied to both sexes
links.outcome: Equalized-odds gap between sexes (fairness audit of 2-year ankle reinjury prediction)
links.effect: Equalized-odds gap 0.384 with a single global threshold, reduced by 57% to 0.164 with sex-specific thresholds; disproportionate-impact ratio 0.683, still below the 0.80 benchmark
links.tradeoff: Disproportionate-impact ratio remained below the 0.80 benchmark; not externally validated, so not ready for clinical deployment.
links.quote: Within-sex discrimination was comparable between males and females, but a single global threshold produced an equalized-odds gap of 0.384 that was reduced by 57% (to 0.164) through sex-specific thresholding without retraining the model.
